'''January 1999 Birmingham tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament played on 31 January 1999 at Birmingham. [[Rod Latham]] finished 4th of 35.<ref name="tourneys">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/tourneys.htm My Tournament Reports], Rod Latham, [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001204191500/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/tourneys.htm Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dst9">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/dst9.htm Pacific Blue Twelve], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319184431/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/dst9.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 31 January 1999
* '''Site:''' Birmingham
* '''Winner:''' Unknown

== Dating ==

The Dark deck is dated 31 January 1999, the date of this event on Latham's results page. The Light deck (lst8) was not preserved.
